integrity: The finite-graph identities were checked by exhaustive exact calculations and separately through direct game-flow projection. Infinite asymptotic claims rely on analytic arguments; numerical simulations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to linear rank-payoff priority games with independent-edge Erdos-Renyi conflict graphs and equally weighted unilateral profile transitions.
On empty graphs the relative squared error is mathematically undefined; the theorem stipulates zero to obtain the first-contact distribution.
The Gaussian centering and variance are proved for p_n=lambda/n with fixed lambda>0, not arbitrary sequences satisfying only np_n->lambda.
The deterministic Hodge energy identity is from Lin et al.; the new claim is the stochastic graph law. Generic probabilistic consequences may have unindexed precedents.
title: Two thresholds and a Gaussian law for priority-network Hodge error
